name: bulktranscripts
description: YouTube transcripts for one video, a whole channel or a playlist, plus YouTube search and free new-upload tracking.

defaultPrompt: Get the transcript of https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ and summarize it.
Pull every transcript from @lexfridman and list the guests who talked about AI safety.
interface.longDescription:
Give Codex clean YouTube transcripts: one video, up to 20 at once, or a whole channel or playlist as one background job (up to 1,000 videos per job, with a start offset for bigger channels and a Shorts or live-streams option). It can also search YouTube, list a channel's or playlist's videos, and check a channel's newest uploads.

Connect your BulkTranscripts account through OAuth (Google sign-in, 30 free credits, no card). Each new transcript or live lookup uses one credit; transcripts already in your library come back free, and checking a channel's newest uploads is never charged. Videos without captions, members-only or private videos are skipped, not charged.
